name: High-value asset held through opaque vehicle
description: Property, art, vessels or other valuables are acquired or held via a company, trust or storage arrangement with concealed beneficial owners.
fp: Privacy-motivated and estate-planning holdings can be lawful; verify beneficial ownership.

Purchase of high-value assets by newly formed entities with opaque owners
links.ctx: Yacht, aircraft, art or property is bought through a company with unclear beneficial owners. Real estate held by shell companies with nominee directors.
